presets.name: Simple notification
presets.description: A title and a body.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: If you can read this, it works.

presets.name: Notification with image
presets.description: A notification with a large image. iOS needs a notification service extension to show it.

presets.name: Notification + data
presets.description: A notification plus key/value data the app reads when it is tapped.

presets.name: Data only (silent / background)
presets.description: No visible notification. The app receives the data in the background.

presets.name: Admin push notification (topic)
presets.description: What Admin panel > Push notification sends to a topic such as all_zone_customer, zone_<id>_customer, all_zone_delivery_man or all_zone_store. Every app shows it and opens the notification list on tap. Rental admin pushes use the type general.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Get 20% off on all orders this weekend.

presets.name: Maintenance mode (silent)
presets.description: Data only, so no notification is shown. maintenance (sent when maintenance mode is turned on or off) makes the apps reload their settings; demo_reset makes the user app show the demo reset dialog. Topics: maintenance_mode_user_app, maintenance_mode_deliveryman_app, maintenance_mode_vendor_app, maintenance_mode_rider_app, demo_reset.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: We are under maintenance. Please check back soon.

presets.name: User app · Order status
presets.description: Sent to the customer when an order changes status. Tapping opens the order details (guests go to the orders tab), and the app reloads its order lists.

presets.name: User app · Chat message
presets.description: A new chat message from a store (vendor), deliveryman or admin. Tapping opens the conversation; while that chat is open the app reloads the messages instead.

presets.name: User app · Wallet & rewards
presets.description: add_fund (also used for wallet debits) and cashback open the wallet; loyalty_point opens loyalty points; referral_code and wallet_transfer open the notification list. add_fund, cashback and loyalty_point also reload the profile.

presets.name: User app · Account (block, unblock, OTP)
presets.description: block and unblock open the sign-in screen on tap. otp carries a delivery OTP for the customer; tapping it does nothing.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Your account has been blocked. Please contact support.

presets.name: User app · Pro subscription & reminders
presets.description: Pro customer subscription updates and the monthly order reminder. Shown as a normal notification; tapping opens the notification list.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Your Pro subscription is now active.

presets.name: User app · Rental trip status
presets.description: A rental trip changed status; the trip ID goes in order_id. Tapping opens the trip details. With the status completed and the app open, the app shows the payment sheet.

presets.name: User app · New coupon (topic)
presets.description: Sent to every customer in the store's zone when a store adds or updates a coupon. Tapping opens the notification list.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Use code SAVE20 to get 20% off.

presets.name: User app · New item for your interests (topic)
presets.description: Sent to customers who follow a category when a store adds an item in it. Tapping opens the notification list.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: A new item you may like is now available.

presets.name: Delivery app · New order request (topic)
presets.description: A new order for the deliverymen of a zone (topic zone_<id>_delivery_man) or of one store (restaurant_dm_<store id>, which may send new_order). With the app open it shows the new request dialog; in the background order_request starts the ringing alert. The order types parcel_order and prescription hide the item count.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: A new order is waiting for a deliveryman.

presets.name: Delivery app · Order assigned
presets.description: A delivery company assigned an order to the deliveryman (the admin panel sends order_status instead). With the app open it shows the assigned order dialog; tapping opens the order details.

presets.name: Delivery app · Order status / unassigned
presets.description: order_status: an order was assigned (from the admin panel) or changed; tapping opens the order details, and in the background it starts the ringing alert. unassign: the order was taken away; tapping opens the order requests tab.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Order 100001 has been assigned to you.

presets.name: Delivery app · Chat message
presets.description: A new chat message from a customer (sender user), store (vendor) or admin. Tapping opens the conversation.

presets.name: Delivery app · Earnings & wallet
presets.description: withdraw (request approved or denied) opens My account; cash_collect, deliveryman_referral and loyalty_point open the notification list.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Your withdraw request has been approved.

presets.name: Delivery app · Account (block, unblock)
presets.description: Careful: with the app open, block signs the deliveryman out at once. Tapping either one opens the sign-in screen.

presets.name: Store app · New order
presets.description: A customer placed an order with the store (store employees get it too). With the app open it shows the new order dialog; in the background it starts the ringing alert. Tapping opens the order details.

presets.name: Store app · Order status
presets.description: An order changed status. Tapping opens the order details (the trip or booking in the rental and service modules); in the background it starts the ringing alert.

presets.name: Store app · Chat message
presets.description: A new chat message from a customer (sender user) or a deliveryman. Tapping opens the conversation.

presets.name: Store app · Item approved / rejected
presets.description: product_approve opens the store's item list; product_rejected opens the pending items.

presets.name: Store app · Advertisement
presets.description: An advertisement was created, approved, denied or paused. Tapping opens the advertisement details, and the app reloads the list.

presets.name: Store app · Campaign
presets.description: The store's request to join a campaign was approved or rejected. Tapping opens the campaign details; the campaign ID goes in data_id.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Your request to join the campaign has been approved.

presets.name: Store app · Account & business
presets.description: subscription opens My subscription; withdraw opens the wallet tab; block and unblock open the sign-in screen; verified_badge opens the notification list.

presets.name: Admin push notification (topic)
presets.description: The admin's push notification from the Notifications page, sent to a topic: all_zone_customer, zone_<id>_customer, all_zone_restaurant, zone_<id>_restaurant, all_zone_delivery_man or zone_<id>_delivery_man.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Enjoy free delivery on all orders this weekend.

presets.name: Maintenance mode (silent)
presets.description: Data only, so no notification is shown. maintenance is sent when maintenance mode is turned on ("maintenance mode" / "We are Working On Something Special!") or off ("We are back" / "Maintenance mode is removed"), to the topics maintenance_mode_user_app, maintenance_mode_deliveryman_app and maintenance_mode_restaurant_app. stackfood_demo_reset (title and body "demo_reset") goes to the topic stackfood_demo_reset, on the demo server only.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: We are Working On Something Special!

presets.name: Customer app · Order status
presets.description: Sent on every order status change, and when a deliveryman accepts the order, the order is ready to be delivered, it is refunded, an offline payment is approved or rejected, or a dine-in table or token number is set. The body comes from the admin's Notification Messages. Titles: Order Notification, order ready to be delivered, order refunded, Your Offline payment was approved / rejected, Here is your Table and Token Number, Refund Rejected.

presets.name: Customer app · Chat message
presets.description: A chat message from the admin, a restaurant (vendor) or a deliveryman (delivery_man). The body is the chat text, or "<n> Attachments". The web copy of a deliveryman's message goes to a topic, without conversation_id and sender_type.

presets.name: Customer app · Wallet & rewards
presets.description: add_fund: funds were added to the wallet. CashBack (spelled so by the backend): cashback earned on an order, with its order_id. referral_code: someone used your referral code (one path hard-codes order_id 1). referral_earn: a referral reward was earned. The amount is not sent; it is only in the body text.

presets.name: Customer app · Account (block, unblock)
presets.description: The admin blocked (block, title "suspended") or unblocked (unblock, title "account activation") the customer's account.

presets.name: Customer app · Pro subscription & reminders
presets.description: StackFood Pro for customers: activated or renewed (customer_subscription_activated), expired, canceled, and the expiry reminder. data_id is the subscription id.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Your Pro subscription is now active.

presets.name: Customer app · Cart abandon reminder
presets.description: Reminds a customer of the items left in the cart. The body is the admin's message with {userName} replaced.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Hi John, you left items in your cart. Complete your order now!

presets.name: Restaurant app · New order
presets.description: A new order for the restaurant app (vendors.firebase_token). The restaurant web panel gets the same order as a topic message: see "Restaurant panel · New order (topic)".

presets.name: Restaurant app · Order picked up
presets.description: Sent to the restaurant only when the order status becomes picked_up.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: The order has been picked up by the deliveryman.

presets.name: Restaurant app · Chat message
presets.description: A chat message from the admin or a customer (user).

presets.name: Restaurant app · Account (block, unblock)
presets.description: The admin blocked (block, title "suspended") or unblocked (unblock, title "Account Activation") the restaurant.

presets.name: Restaurant app · Withdraw approved / rejected
presets.description: The admin approved or rejected a withdraw request. Titles: Withdraw approved, Withdraw rejected.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Your withdraw request has been approved.

presets.name: Restaurant app · Advertisement
presets.description: Titles: New Advertisement, Advertisement Approved, Advertisement Denied, Advertisement Paused, Advertisement Resumed. advertisement_id is the ad's id.

presets.name: Restaurant app · Subscription
presets.description: The restaurant's business plan. Titles: subscription successful, subscription renewed, subscription shifted, subscription plan updated, subscription canceled.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Your subscription plan is now active.

presets.name: Restaurant app · Promotion request (campaign, BOGO, happy hour)
presets.description: The admin's answer to the restaurant's request to join a promotion. data_id is the campaign, BOGO offer or happy hour id. Titles: Campaign Request Approved / Rejected; BOGO Request, BOGO Request Approved / Rejected, BOGO Offer Withdrawn; Happy Hour Request, Happy Hour Request Approved / Rejected.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Your request to join the campaign has been approved.

variables.label: Campaign, BOGO or happy hour ID

presets.name: Restaurant app · New BOGO / happy hour available (topic)
presets.description: A new promotion restaurants can join. bogo_offer goes to the topic all_zone_restaurant; happy_hour ("New Happy Hour Available") goes to zone_<id>_restaurant. The offer id is not sent.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: A new BOGO is available. Enroll now to boost your sales

presets.name: Restaurant app · Verified badge
presets.description: The admin verified the restaurant, or removed the badge (title "Removed", body "Your restaurant account is no longer verified.").

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Congratulations! Your restaurant account is now verified.

presets.name: Restaurant panel · New order (topic)
presets.description: Web push for the restaurant web panel, to the topic restaurant_panel_<restaurant id>_message. click_action opens the panel's order list.

presets.name: Deliveryman app · New order request (topic)
presets.description: A new order for the deliverymen of a zone (the zone's topic, delivery_man_<zone>_<vehicle>_<shift> or delivery_man_<zone>_<vehicle>), or of one restaurant (restaurant_dm_<restaurant id>), which may send new_order instead of order_request.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: A new order is waiting for a deliveryman.

presets.name: Deliveryman app · Order status
presets.description: Sent to the deliveryman while the order is processing or handed over.

presets.name: Deliveryman app · Order assigned / unassigned
presets.description: The admin or the restaurant assigned an order to the deliveryman (assign, title "Order Assigned") or took it back (unassign, title "order unassigned"). order_id is sent empty; the order id is only in the body.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Order #100045 has been assigned to you.

presets.name: Deliveryman app · Cash collected
presets.description: The admin collected cash in hand from the deliveryman.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: The admin collected cash from you.

presets.name: Deliveryman app · Shift updated
presets.description: The admin changed the deliveryman's shift. The backend spells the type delivery_nam_shift_update.

presets.name: Deliveryman app · Account (block, unblock)
presets.description: The admin or the restaurant blocked (block, title "suspended") or unblocked (unblock, title "Account activation") the deliveryman.

presets.name: Deliveryman app · Chat message
presets.description: A chat message from a customer (sender_type user).

presets.name: Admin panel · New order (topic)
presets.description: Web push for the admin panel, to the topic admin_message. click_action opens the admin's order list.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: New order alert, confirm to proceed

presets.name: Admin panel · Chat message (topic)
presets.description: A chat message from a customer or a restaurant, to the topic admin_message. The restaurant web panel sends the chat text as the body.

presets.name: Push notification (topic)
presets.description: The admin's push notification campaign, to the topic sixvalley (retail) or sixvalley_wholesale (wholesale). The backend sends the image as its stored file name, e.g. 2026-10-06-6702a1b2c3d4e.webp, not a URL.

presets.name: Maintenance mode (silent)
presets.description: Data only, so no notification is shown. Sent when the admin turns maintenance mode on ("Maintenance Mode start") or off ("Maintenance Mode End") for some apps, to the topics maintenance_mode_start_user_app, maintenance_mode_start_vendor and maintenance_mode_start_deliveryman.

presets.name: Demo reset (topic)
presets.description: Sent to the topic demo_reset when the demo database is refreshed.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Demo data is being reset to default.

presets.name: Chat message
presets.description: A new chat message to a customer, a seller or a delivery man. message_key and notification_key are message_from_<sender>, and notification_from is the sender. It has its own envelope, without order_details_id and the auction and recipient keys.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: You have a new message from Smart Shop.

presets.name: Withdraw approved / denied
presets.description: The admin or the vendor approved or denied a withdraw request of a seller or a delivery man. Titles: Withdraw request approved, Withdraw request denied.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Your withdraw request has been approved.

presets.name: Auction (owner)
presets.description: Sent to the owner of an auction (a seller or a customer), on the app and the web token. type and message_key are the same.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Your auction has a new bid.

presets.name: Customer app · Order status
presets.description: Order status changes, order edits and refund decisions. message_key is the raw status (e.g. delivered) or, for edits and refunds, the template key. Refund messages also set order_details_id.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Hi John Doe, your order #100045 has been delivered.

presets.name: Customer app · Delivery verification code
presets.description: Sent when the delivery man asks for the delivery verification code to be sent again (v6 API).

presets.name: Customer app · Referral
presets.description: To the customer whose referral code was used. A new sign-up has no message_key (title "Someone registered using your referral code!"); an order of the referred customer (retail only) has the message_key your_referred_customer_has_been_place_order or your_referred_customer_order_has_been_delivered and the title "Referral Reward Updates".

variables.label: Title
variables.defaultValue: Someone registered using your referral code!

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: You earn a reward when someone orders with your referral code.

presets.name: Customer app · Fund added
presets.description: The admin added funds to the customer's wallet. The amount is in the title; message_key is empty.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Admin added fund to your wallet.

presets.name: Customer app · Auction (bidder)
presets.description: Sent to a customer taking part in an auction, on the app and the web token. type and message_key are the same. auction_outbid and auction_went_live don't set the product name and thumbnail.

presets.name: Customer app · Product restocked (topic)
presets.description: To the customers who asked to hear about a restock, on the topic restock_<restock request id>_product_restock_<product id>_topic. The title is the product name. No iOS sound.

presets.name: Seller app · Order status
presets.description: A new order, an order edit, a status change, or a delivery man assigned by the admin.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: You have a new order #100045 from John Doe.

presets.name: Seller app · Refund request
presets.description: A customer asked for a refund (refund_request_message), or the admin changed its status (refund_request_status_changed_by_admin).

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: A refund request was placed on order #100045.

presets.name: Seller app · Product approved / rejected
presets.description: The admin approved or rejected a product. type is product_request_approved_message even for a rejection; message_key tells them apart. The title is the translated message key.

presets.name: Seller app · Restock requests
presets.description: Customers asked for a product to be restocked. A minimal message: no type, no is_read and no iOS sound. Bodies: This product has <n> Restock Request, This product has 99+ Restock Request, <n> More products have restock request.

presets.name: Seller app · Theme changed (topic)
presets.description: The admin told every vendor about a theme change, on the topic six_valley_seller. No type is passed, so type is empty.

presets.name: Delivery man app · Order status
presets.description: An order was assigned, rescheduled, canceled or edited, or its expected delivery date or delivery charge changed. message_key is always empty for these.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Order #100045 has been assigned to you.

presets.name: Delivery man app · Cash collected
presets.description: The admin or the vendor collected cash from the delivery man. The amount is in the title.

presets.name: Admin panel · Auction (topic)
presets.description: Auction events for the admin, on the topic admin. type and message_key are the same.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: A claim was submitted for an auction.

presets.name: Chat message
presets.description: A chat message in a trip, to the customer or the driver. type is the chat channel id (so body_loc_key is too) and user_name is the sender.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: You got a new message from John Doe.

presets.name: Wallet & rewards
presets.description: fund_added_by_admin and fund_added_digitally: money added to a customer's wallet. referral_reward_received and someone_used_your_code: to the customer or driver whose referral code was used. For fund_added_by_admin and the referral ones the backend puts the user's own id in ride_request_id.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Admin has added $20.00 to your wallet.

presets.name: Level up
presets.description: A customer or driver reached a new level. A customer without a reward gets the action no_rewards; a driver without a reward keeps level_up and gets reward_type no_rewards.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: You have completed your challenges and reached level Gold.

presets.name: Review received
presets.description: review_from_driver goes to the customer, review_from_customer to the driver.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: New review from a driver! See what he had to say about your trip.

presets.name: Legal pages updated
presets.description: To every active customer and driver when the admin saves the legal, privacy policy or terms and conditions page.

presets.name: Safety alert
presets.description: safety_problem_resolved goes to the customer or driver who sent a safety alert, when the admin marks it solved. type is safety_alert.

presets.name: Maintenance mode (topic)
presets.description: The admin turned maintenance mode on or off, to the topics customer_maintenance_mode_on / _off and driver_maintenance_mode_on / _off. Titles: Server is under maintenance, Server running now.

presets.name: Marketing notification (topic)
presets.description: The admin's marketing notification, to the topic customers_send_notification or drivers_send_notification.

presets.name: Customer app · Ride status
presets.description: Ride updates for the customer. Scheduled rides use the same actions (trip_accepted, trip_booked and trip_edited are scheduled only). searching_for_rider: the driver canceled and a new search started; ride_request_id and new_trip_id are the new trip.

presets.name: Customer app · Shared ride
presets.description: Shared ride updates for a passenger, including other passengers joining, being picked up or canceling.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: A Shared passenger has been matched for your trip.

presets.name: Customer app · Bids
presets.description: A driver placed a bid on the customer's trip.

presets.name: Customer app · Parcel status
presets.description: Parcel updates for the customer. parcel_returning_otp carries the return OTP in the body.

presets.name: Customer app · Parcel refund
presets.description: The admin decided a parcel refund. The backend sends the trip id as type for refund_accepted and refund_denied, coupon for refunded_as_coupon (with the coupon id as ride_request_id) and wallet for refunded_to_wallet.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: For parcel ID #100245 your refund request has been approved by admin. You will be refunded soon.

presets.name: Customer app · Driver nearby / verify identity
presets.description: auto_arrival_notification_customer_message: the driver is a few minutes away (title "Driver is Nearby", body from the business settings). verify_driver_identity: asks the customer to check the driver (title "Verify Driver Identity").

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Your driver will arrive in 2 min.

presets.name: Driver app · New ride request
presets.description: A new trip near the driver: a ride, a shared ride or a parcel (type parcel). Scheduled rides use new_ride_request.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: You have a new ride request.

presets.name: Driver app · Trip updates
presets.description: Trip updates for the driver. trip_canceled_for_driver_identity_mismatch also sets trip_readable_id and trip_cancellation_time. coupon_applied and coupon_removed come from older code.

presets.name: Driver app · Parcel
presets.description: Parcel updates for the driver. For the refund and amount actions the backend sends the trip id as type.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Parcel canceled. Please return the parcel within 2 hours.

presets.name: Driver app · Account & verification
presets.description: Changes to the driver's account, vehicle and verification. cash_in_hand_limit_exceeds puts the driver id in ride_request_id.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Your identity image update request is approved.

presets.name: Driver app · Wallet & withdraw
presets.description: Cash collected by the admin, a digital payment to the admin, and withdraw request decisions.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: We are pleased to inform you that your withdrawal request has been approved.

presets.name: Driver app · Message from admin
presets.description: A chat message from the admin. ride_request_id is the driver id and type is the chat channel id.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: You got a new message from admin.

presets.name: Admin panel · New trip request (topic)
presets.description: A new trip was requested, to the topic admin_notification. The backend sends the image as the string "null".

presets.name: Admin panel · Safety alert (topic)
presets.description: A customer or driver sent (or resent) a safety alert, to the topic admin_safety_alert_notification. type is who sent it.

presets.name: Customer app · Booking status
presets.description: Booking updates for the customer: booking_place, booking status changes (the key comes from the booking status), booking_ignored_by_provider, service_location_updated, otp, offline_payment_approved and refund. booking_type is regular or repeat; repeat bookings may also set repeat_type single. The backend sets type and group with notification_type() / notification_group() for the notification key; type them in. The default type is the notification key.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Your booking has been placed successfully.

presets.name: Customer app · Custom booking & bids
presets.description: customized_booking_request, customer_notification_for_provider_bid_offer, customer_notification_for_provider_bid_withdraw and customized_booking_request_delete. post_id is the customer's request; provider_id is set for a bid offer. The backend sets type and group with notification_type() / notification_group() for the notification key; type them in. The default type is the notification key.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Smart Cleaners offered $50.00 for your request.

presets.name: Customer app · Wallet, referral & loyalty
presets.description: referral_code_used, referral_earning, referral_earning_first_booking, loyalty_point, add_fund_wallet and add_fund_wallet_bonus. Most set user_id to the customer. The backend sets type and group with notification_type() / notification_group() for the notification key; type them in. The default type is the notification key.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: $20.00 has been added to your wallet.

presets.name: Customer app · Account & subscription
presets.description: customer_notification_for_availability_status, account_deactivated (also sent to providers and servicemen), the subscription keys, and service_suggestion_approve / service_suggestion_deny. The backend sets type and group with notification_type() / notification_group() for the notification key; type them in. The default type is the notification key.

presets.name: Provider app · Booking
presets.description: new_service_request_arrived, booking_accepted, admin_assigned_booking and booking status changes for the provider. booking_type is regular or repeat. The backend sets type and group with notification_type() / notification_group() for the notification key; type them in. The default type is the notification key.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: A new service request has arrived.

presets.name: Provider app · Bids
presets.description: new_service_request_arrived for a customer's custom request (post_id), and provider_bid_request_denied (provider_id). These come with an empty body. The backend sets type and group with notification_type() / notification_group() for the notification key; type them in. The default type is the notification key.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: A customer posted a new service request.

presets.name: Provider app · Account & payments
presets.description: provider_suspend, provider_suspension_remove (booking_id carries the provider id), admin_payable, provider_verified, withdraw_request_approve and withdraw_request_deny. The backend sets type and group with notification_type() / notification_group() for the notification key; type them in. The default type is the notification key.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Your account has been suspended. Pay $120.00 to the admin to continue.

presets.name: Provider app · Advertisements & campaigns
presets.description: advertisement_created_by_admin, advertisement_paused (with advertisement_id) and the campaign keys. The backend sets type and group with notification_type() / notification_group() for the notification key; type them in. The default type is the notification key.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: The admin created an advertisement for Smart Cleaners.

presets.name: Provider app · Service suggestions & requests
presets.description: service_suggestion_approve, service_suggestion_deny and the service request approval keys. The backend sets type and group with notification_type() / notification_group() for the notification key; type them in. The default type is the notification key.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Your service suggestion has been approved.

presets.name: Serviceman app · Booking
presets.description: Booking status changes for the serviceman. Repeat bookings set booking_type repeat and repeat_type single. The backend sets type and group with notification_type() / notification_group() for the notification key; type them in. The default type is the notification key.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: You have been assigned a booking.

presets.name: Chat message
presets.description: new_message to a customer, provider or serviceman. channel_id is the conversation; user_name, user_image, user_phone and user_type describe the sender. The backend sets type and group with notification_type() / notification_group() for the notification key; type them in. The default type is the notification key.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: You have a new message from John Doe.

presets.name: Push notification (topic)
presets.description: The admin's push notification, to the topic <audience>-<zone id> (audience: customer, provider-admin, provider-serviceman or all).

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Book any cleaning service and get 20% off.

presets.name: Pages updated (topic)
presets.description: The admin updated the terms and conditions or the privacy policy, to the topics customer, provider-admin and provider-serviceman.

presets.name: Business model updated (topic)
presets.description: The admin changed the business model (commission or subscription). type and group come from BusinessModelNotificationService::PUSH_TYPE / PUSH_GROUP; type them in.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: The business model has been updated.

presets.name: Provider app · New booking alert (topic)
presets.description: A new booking in the provider's zone, to the topic demandium_provider_<zone id>_booking_message. The body is empty.

presets.name: Provider app · Provider settings updated (topic)
presets.description: The admin turned service at the provider's place on or off, to the topic provider-admin.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Service at provider place has been actived

presets.name: Provider app · Verified (topic)
presets.description: The admin verified the provider, to the topic demandium_provider_<zone id>_<provider id>_booking_message. The backend sets type and group with notification_type() / notification_group() for the notification key; type them in. The default type is the notification key.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Congratulations! Smart Cleaners is now verified.

presets.name: Maintenance mode (silent)
presets.description: Data only, so no notification is shown. Sent when maintenance mode changes, with an empty body.

presets.name: Demo reset (silent)
presets.description: Data only. Sent when the demo data is reset to default.

variables.label: Body
variables.defaultValue: Demo data is being reset to default.
